findings.problem: Promises a reply: "just reply to this email and a real person will answer." Rule 9 bans reply promises unless the owner has confirmed them. The same line is in all 3 group versions (daily-drinkers, gift-buyers, tea-curious).
findings.fix: Get the owner to confirm someone monitors replies. If they can't, cut the line or change it to "Still wondering? Take a look at The Steep Club page."

findings.problem: "We will always tell you when your box has been sent" promises a shipping notice. Rule 9 bans this unless confirmed. It is also stiff ("We will" instead of "We'll"). The same line is in all 3 group versions.
findings.fix: Remove it, or confirm that shipping notices go out. If confirmed, write "We'll let you know when your box is on its way."

findings.problem: "It's quick. Press the button, choose your box, and you're in." is a claim about sign-up time, and it implies a choice of boxes that isn't confirmed. Rule 9 bans sign-up time claims unless confirmed. The same line is in all 3 group versions.
findings.fix: Remove "It's quick." and "choose your box" unless the owner confirms them. For example: "Press the button and we'll take you through the steps."

findings.problem: The fallback line "There is no deadline from us. The door stays open, and you can join whenever you are ready." is a promise about deadlines and sign-up time. It sits inside a [TO CONFIRM] block, so it is only a problem if it ships unconfirmed. The same line is in all 3 group versions.
findings.fix: Keep it only if the owner confirms that joining stays open with no close date. Otherwise state the real close date.

findings.problem: The heading "I am new to tea. Is this for me?" has no contraction, which is stiff for this brand's voice (rule 7). The same line is in all 3 group versions.
findings.fix: Change it to "I'm new to tea. Is this for me?"
